column2: ICE and DHS should be abolished, INS should be restored and immigration policy should be reformed to be far more humane. All of these employees should be barred from any and all future public service (and prosecuted where appropriate). There's no room for sympathy for an agency who routinely violates human rights, fires off tear gas by schools, kills civilians in the streets, fires their weapons into moving vehicles and on and on.
The Germans knew to identify ex Stasi and their informants so they know who to beware of.
The real importance of this is archival. Who knows what would have been burned and shredded to protect the masked brutes.
